calls.title: Superhuman + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Superhuman's team faces challenges with a hybrid experimentation platform that combines in-house tools with third-party providers, resulting in issues like lifecycle management and experimentation hygiene, particularly with unique use cases for 'closed state' experiments. Their reliance on Statsig creates scalability gaps, while varied experimentation maturity across teams leads to inconsistent best practices. In contrast, GrowthBook offers a warehouse-native architecture, AI-powered agentic workflows, and extensive metric governance controls aimed at streamlining experimentation. GrowthBook emphasizes incremental adoption to alleviate migration risks and introduces innovative features like sticky bucketing to preserve user assignments post-enrollment. Superhuman is interested in exploring the integration of GrowthBook components while enhancing their experimentation culture through training and advisory services.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Metrics Customization, A/B Testing, AI Integration, Warehouse Native, Experiment Lifecycle
